crossRefs.note: Now therefore, please make a pledge to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses, if you…
How then can you turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put your trust on Egypt…
‘Tell Hezekiah king of Judah this: “Don’t let your God in whom you trust deceive you, saying, Jerusalem will not be…
“For the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will bring on Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, from the north…
You, O king, are king of kings, to whom the God of heaven has given the kingdom, the power, the strength, and the glory.

translations.web: For he says, “Aren’t all of my princes kings?
translations.bsb: “Are not all my commanders kings?” he says.
translations.kjv: For he saith, Are not my princes altogether kings?
translations.asv: For he saith, Are not my princes all of them kings?
